basis: Random grid scan of the sea between the four live hot spots (decision 2026-10-30, user). Each round visits every tile of hotspot-tests/grid.json once in random order. A tile is finished before the next one starts: its two scenes (different days) are queued together, and a pair on the first one marks the tile processed at once.

first_dates_per_day.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: 25 random tiles a day get their first scene.

max_scans_per_day.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: at most 50 scenes queued per UTC day, which is 25 tiles of two scenes.

dates_per_tile.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: each tile gets two scenes on different days, queued together so a tile is finished before the next starts. A pair on the first scene finishes the tile; its second scene may already be queued and then runs without being needed.

scenes_queued_with_first.basis: User decision 2026-10-31: a cell queues only its first scene; the second (dates_per_tile is 2) is queued when the first has no pair, and a pair on the first scene ends the cell. Setting it to 2 queues both together as before.

grids_in_flight.basis: 2026-10-31 (user): every drawn cell's first scene is queued at once so the worker never waits for the planner; the second scene follows when the first has no pair. Before this the limit was 2, which left the worker idle for minutes between planner steps.

failed_retries.basis: User decision 2026-11-02: a cell whose scene failed is run again once, after every other cell of the run is decided and before the run finishes. The failures that prompted it came from the worker session being killed at the old 4 hour cap (removed 2026-11-02). Applies to runs (batch); the unattended plan command still closes a failed cell at once.

window_days.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: scenes are drawn at random from the last 30 days.

window_max_days.basis: User decision 2026-10-30: when the 30-day window holds no usable scene the window widens to 60 days and no further.

source_order.basis: S1 first: the live sites give 3.7 to 6.1 pairs per S1 scene against 1.0 to 1.65 per S2 scene (docs/feasibility.md, predicting pair locations), so one empty S1 scene is far stronger evidence than one empty S2 scene. S2 is used when a tile has no usable S1 scene in the window. S2 cloud limit is scene.s2_max_cloud_pct in sts_graph.json.

s1_scene_modes.basis: User decision 2026-11-02: only Sentinel-1 IW GRDH scenes are taken (the scene id carries the mode, S1x_IW_GRDH_...). The one EW GRDM scene in 145 S1 grid scenes (cell 44PPA, 2026-10-28) failed with 'job has 1 incomplete scenes' while all 144 IW GRDH scenes succeeded, so excluding the other modes removes 1 failure and loses 0 working scenes. A tile whose only S1 scenes are another mode falls through to S2.

s1_reference_required.basis: User decision 2026-11-03: an S1 scene is taken only when the worker's reference search (sts_graph.json s1_reference_image: same orbit direction, 30 to 90 days before) finds an image, the same test the detector applies. Cell 45QSV's only S1 scene in the window (2026-10-31, an ascending S1C pass) failed twice with 'no Sentinel-1 reference': all 109 S1 images of that tile in the six months before are descending. A tile with no such S1 scene falls through to S2.

hit_verdicts.basis: Run verdicts of the scene that count as a pair for the visit decision. These are automatic labels: a hit marks the tile a candidate for review, not a confirmed pair (run 91 was a haze false pair).

min_hulls_for_second_date.note: A first scene below this many checked hulls would close the tile as quiet without a second date. Left null until the hull counts of the first scenes show where to cut.

min_shore_distance_m.basis: Same shore mask as every hot spot and test area (decision 2026-10-19).

result_wait_days.basis: A queued scene with no review result after this many days is reported as stuck in the status output; it is not retried automatically.

batch_poll_minutes.basis: User decision 2026-10-31: the planner step repeats every minute so a second scene is queued within about a minute of its first scene's result and the worker keeps its drain session; a step with nothing to do leaves no scan row.

request_stale_minutes.basis: User decision 2026-11-01: a run requested from the page counts as interrupted when its process has not beat for this long (the planner beats every batch_poll_minutes) or a request was not picked up in that time, so the page offers Continue run instead of staying disabled.

promotion_min_pairs_per_scene_s1.basis: User decision 2026-11-02: an area (a pair cell and its adjacent ring, all dates) is a hot-spot candidate when its QA-confirmed pairs per scanned S1 scene reach this value, about half of the weakest live hot spot (johor_east_scs 0.83 per S1 scene; docs/feasibility.md). Random cells measured 0.03 on 2026-11-02 (4 pairs in 116 S1 scenes).

promotion_min_pairs_per_scene_s2.note: Live S2 hot spots run 1.0 to 1.65 pairs per scene and the random cells found none in 79 scenes; not set until the user picks it.
